name: xtapp-studio-mcp
description: XTApp Studio MCP: Lua contract knowledge, public app templates, and a live Studio preview for any MCP host.

interface.shortDescription: Run XTApp projects, search Lua contracts, and browse public app templates.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local MCP server and native Widget for XTApp project validation, preview orchestration, contract knowledge, and public store templates.
defaultPrompt: Create todo-list in this folder and make a todo app that can add, complete, and delete. Classic uses d-pad and OK. Pro also supports touch.
Search the XTApp Lua contract for this feature.
Find a public XTApp app I can use as a template.
